key_highlights: ASX tumbles as miners and banks sell off amid $100 oil spike and rising bond yields; Middle East geopolitical risk amplifies volatility
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; however WA gold exploration activity remains robust (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania)
Australian business conditions weakest since pandemic; AUD shocker looms as oil-driven inflation pressures RBA policy path
Queensland near credit rating downgrade; NSW faces massive stamp duty revenue hit from property softening
Gas reservation debate intensifies: Labor pivots from tax to reservation, but critics allege policy reversal; Australia softens local gas supply rules easing Asian fears
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market; banks allegedly defrauded up to $600m raises financial sector governance concerns

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness spreads, dragging major miners lower. However, gold exploration in WA and NSW shows strong momentum with multiple high-grade discoveries. Copper prices rising on supply concerns.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term headwinds from iron ore softness. Gold juniors (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Kuniko) attract speculative flows. Flagship's copper expansion signals structural demand. Diversified miners preferred over pure iron ore plays.

sectors.trend: Banks sell off on rising bond yields and fraud allegations. Bathla's collapse creates contagion risk in private credit. Queensland downgrade threat pressures state-linked lending.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from yield volatility and credit event risk. $600m fraud case raises governance scrutiny. Private credit exposure a key risk factor for diversified lenders.

sectors.trend: Oil near $100 triggers TACO (Trump And Chill On) dynamics. Gas reservation policy in flux. Data centre power demand strains NSW grid. Australia softens gas export rules.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from gas reservation certainty. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (Powerlink/Origin) creates transition risk. Oil spike supports upstream but pressures downstream and transport.

sectors.trend: Medicare review recommends rebate increases; CSL remains defensive anchor. Wall Street billionaire father bets on vision-restoration treatment.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX benefit from policy tailwind on rebates. Biotech/medtech small caps may see flows from treatment innovation headlines.

sectors.trend: High-end property sees steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. NSW stamp duty revenue hit. Migrant-driven demand persists but sham contracting concerns emerge.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals. Property developers cautious. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) offer relative safety. Housing 'collapse' narrative likely overstated per Jericho.

sectors.trend: AI data centres driving power demand and energy transition disruption. Meta AI weapon, TSMC rally, Arm edge-device expansion signal global AI capex cycle continuing.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names limited but power/infrastructure beneficiaries (SGH, AGL.AX) gain. Global AI capex supports semiconductor supply chain. Brisbane AI traffic lights signal local adoption.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds as volatility hedge

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil at $100, iron ore weakness, and rising bond yields create a risk-off backdrop. Middle East escalation is the key wildcard. Gold and gas names outperform; banks and iron ore lag. AUD likely to weaken further. RBA caught between imported inflation and softening domestic activity.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and iron ore stabilises. WA gold exploration pipeline and copper supply tightness support materials sector. Gas reservation provides structural support to energy. Housing bifurcation continues—luxury weak, affordable resilient. AI data centre power demand creates long-term energy infrastructure investment theme. Key risk: prolonged Middle East conflict or Chinese demand collapse.
